# wso2is_organization_discovery (Resource)

Sets the email domains of a sub-organization's users, for email domain discovery. The login page then sends users with these domains to the organization. Turn on email domain discovery first with `wso2is_organization_discovery_configuration`, or the server answers `ORG-60080`. Add `depends_on` for that resource, so that Terraform also removes the domains before it turns discovery off. Manage this resource from the root organization. To import, use the organization ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Turn on email domain discovery for the tenant first.
resource "wso2is_organization_discovery_configuration" "this" {
  email_domain_enabled = true
}

resource "wso2is_organization" "partner" {
  name = "Partner Inc"
}

# Users with an @partner.example or @partner-eu.example address go to Partner Inc's login.
resource "wso2is_organization_discovery" "partner" {
  organization_id = wso2is_organization.partner.id
  email_domains   = ["partner.example", "partner-eu.example"]
  depends_on      = [wso2is_organization_discovery_configuration.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_domains` (Set of String) Email domains of the organization's users, for example `partner.example`. A domain can belong to one organization only.
- `organization_id` (String) Sub-organization ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `organization_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_organization_discovery.partner <organization_id>
```
